author: reek
body: Import-by-hash and the trust gate. Alice is fully trusted. Bob is trusted only by Alice's vouch for him, so his score is the decayed one. Mallory holds a key we never registered.

author: reek
body: A fact whose stored hash does not describe its content. This is the one the integrity guard is for, and it is checked before the signature is ever consulted.

author: reek
body: The supply-chain attack in its plainest form: Alice's real signature, lifted off a definition she did stand behind, and pasted onto one she did not.
